bibl.title: Ancora su P.Oxy. LIII 3705
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, Ancora su P. Oxy. LIII 3705.
bibl.note: Here are some observations about a problematic P.Oxy. LIII, 3705 (= MP3 1305.21; LDAB 2690), in which the verse 796 of Menander's Perikeiromene is repeated four times and on each line there is a vocal notation with presumed writing errors.
